name: rea
description: Reverse engineer binaries, applications and runtime behavior with REA through one MCP server.

extraEnvJson.description: Additional REA environment variables as a JSON object (escape hatch for REA_* knobs not listed here).
extraEnvJson.title: Extra environment (JSON)

ghidraInstallDir.title: Ghidra install directory

reaBrowserExecutable.description: Chrome-family browser executable for website and Electron runtime targets. Leave empty to use the system-installed browser.

reaIlspyCmdPath.title: ilspycmd path

reaTsharkCommand.description: tshark command for packet capture analysis (Linux).
